categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in semiconductor storage device testing equipment and new display device inspection equipment. The company focuses on providing testing and inspection solutions for DRAM and NAND Flash semiconductor memory devices, as well as AMOLED, Micro LED, Micro OLED, and other new display technologies. Their product lines include wafer testing systems, aging test and repair systems, packaging test systems, optical inspection and calibration systems, aging systems, signal generators, and testing system accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including Algorithmic Pattern Generator (ALPG), DRAM repair algorithms, MEMS probe card design and manufacturing, high-precision timing signal generation, high-speed signal interconnection, automated PCB delay testing, uniform temperature control in aging chambers, Micro LED wafer lighting detection, high-resolution imaging colorimeters, AI-based defect detection platforms, and advanced packaging test equipment. Production follows a make-to-order model with strict adherence to hardware drawings and process specifications, including material procurement, hardware assembly, software installation, and system debugging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic semiconductor memory manufacturers such as ChangXin Memory Technologies and PeiDun Technology, and leading new display manufacturers like BOE Technology, TCL Technology, Visionox, and Tianma Microelectronics. The company serves industries involved in semiconductor memory production, AMOLED and micro-display manufacturing, and emerging AR/VR terminal device markets. The company has also expanded into overseas markets, securing orders from leading AR/VR terminal manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant business in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta regions, including subsidiaries in Nanjing, Suzhou, Changsha, and Hefei. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for overseas procurement and sales. The company has begun expanding its overseas market presence, particularly in AR/VR micro-display sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen SEICHI Technologies operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and display device supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of testing and inspection equipment used by downstream semiconductor memory and display manufacturers. It provides critical testing solutions during wafer fabrication, packaging, and module assembly stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation with increased R&D investment, focusing on advanced semiconductor testing technologies such as DRAM high-speed testing, SoC testing for AI chips, advanced packaging test equipment (2.5D/3D/Chiplet), and new display inspection technologies including Micro LED/OLED and AI-enhanced defect detection. It aims to expand product lines, improve system integration capabilities, and enhance domestic substitution of imported equipment. The R&D team is sizable and growing, with a strong patent portfolio and ongoing projects targeting international advanced standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of testing and inspection equipment and related accessories to semiconductor and display device manufacturers. Additional income comes from equipment maintenance and service contracts. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through negotiations and tenders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international semiconductor test equipment providers such as Advantest and Teradyne, especially in the DRAM testing segment. It has established itself as a leading domestic supplier with a comprehensive product portfolio covering all major testing stages, achieving significant domestic substitution. In new display inspection, it holds a leading position in China with growing market share and has secured orders from top-tier domestic and international customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 803 million, a 23.83% increase year-over-year, with semiconductor business revenue growing nearly 200%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 80.16 million, down 30.71% due to increased R&D investment and margin pressure during growth. Total assets reached RMB 2.03 billion with net assets of RMB 1.72 billion. The company maintains a robust financial position with steady growth and increased R&D spending accounting for 13.66% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, system-level testing solutions with strong domestic innovation capabilities, enabling high compatibility and customization for advanced semiconductor and display manufacturing processes. Its products support advanced packaging technologies and AI-driven inspection, providing high precision, reliability, and cost-effective alternatives to imported equipment. The company emphasizes strong after-sales technical support and local service advantages, fostering deep customer trust and enabling supply chain localization.
